description: Documentation source file for the Browser class in Playwright, describing its methods, events, and usage examples across multiple programming languages.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Represents a web browser instance in Playwright, providing methods to control browser lifecycle, contexts, pages, and tracing.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Emitted when the Browser gets disconnected from the browser application.

methods.name: browserType
methods.description: Returns the type of the browser (chromium, firefox, webkit).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser and all of its pages and contexts.

methods.name: contexts
methods.description: Returns an array of all open browser contexts.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the browser is currently connected.

methods.name: newBrowserCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session (Chromium only).

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page in a new browser context.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all listeners of the specified type.

methods.name: startTracing
methods.description: Starts Chromium tracing for performance analysis.

methods.name: stopTracing
methods.description: Stops tracing and returns the trace data buffer.
